senses.gloss:
r. 4th and 7th cls. (खिद्यते and खिंते)
To be distrest, to suffer pain or misery.
(औ, प) औखिदप् r. 6th cl. (खिन्दति)
To afflict or distress.

m. (-रः)
The moon.
2 An ascetic, a penitent.
3 A pauper.
E.
खिद to suffer pain, किरच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Suffering pain or distress.
E.
खिद, with शानच् aff.

m. (-द्रः)
1 Disease, sickness.
2 A pauper, a poor man.
E.
खिद, to be in pain, रक् Uṇādi aff.
